decisions.reason: A multi-model desk line with its own page represents a substantial, visible investment tied to the firm's flexible-workplace direction, so management will persist with it.
The chair family sits close to the core offer and is presented prominently, so dropping it would write off visible development and designer work with little justification.
The floor cushions are a multi-model line with their own page and connect to the rug and material expertise, so weak early results can still be read as a slow start.
The sofa is only mentioned on the website, so public commitment is low, but it sits close to the core upholstery offer and one year is too early to judge it.
The high table is a low-risk addition close to the core with its own page and fits the conference and lounge offer, so management keeps it.
The rug collection is publicly presented as a flagship of the firm's direction, so even disappointing results would be attributed to market entry costs rather than taken as grounds to drop it.
